spans.s: Cīna-pagoda (SII 12), ‘Chinese shrine’; name of a Buddhist temple at Nāgapaṭṭanam.

cinna (EI 3; SITI), name of a coin; sometimes regarded as a fanam (CITD); also spelt sinna in Telugu; a weight equal to (1/30) of a tola and called a Canteroy fanam; one-eighth part of a coin called pagoda; the weight of 4 guri-giñjas.
cinna , also spelt sinna; same as fanam (q. v.); (1/8) of a pagoda (q. v.)
